title: lygodium pedatum
intro: Lygodium pedatum, commonly known as Australian fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lygodiaceae. The plant is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in providing relief from various health issues. It is rich in health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer properties.
